tests.title: Technical diagnosis
tests.prompt:
A user reports that https://portal.intra no longer opens.

DNS:
portal.intra -> 10.20.30.40

ping portal.intra:
4 packets transmitted, 4 received

curl -Iv https://portal.intra:
Connected to portal.intra (10.20.30.40) port 443
SSL certificate problem: certificate has expired

Briefly state: 1. what is known; 2. the most likely cause; 3. the next action. Do not invent missing information.

tests.title: Hypothesis ranking
tests.prompt: Two web servers A and B are behind the same load balancer. Server A runs build 2026.09.14. Server B runs build 2026.09.11. Both use the same Redis instance. Requests are distributed randomly. Only some requests to /api/profile return {}. Rank the most likely hypotheses and give concrete checks. Clearly distinguish facts from hypotheses. Do not invent measurements.

tests.title: Decision under constraints
tests.prompt: Two production web servers are behind one load balancer. Requirements: no downtime, no new infrastructure, reproducible deployments, and rollback support. Compare A: manually updating both servers, with B: an automated rolling deployment. Choose one and briefly describe the safe procedure.

tests.title: Incident handover
tests.prompt: Create an incident handover with exactly these four headings: FACTS, LIKELY CAUSE, TO VERIFY, ACTIONS. Since 14:10 about 20% of /api/orders requests return HTTP 500. Server A runs build 5512 and B runs 5508. The error is not correlated to a backend. Redis latency is normal. One server A log line contains NullPointerException in OrderPresenter, but it is not confirmed to belong to the failing requests. Never put suspicions under FACTS as a proven cause.

tests.title: Unknown database version
tests.prompt: The application uses PostgreSQL. No version information is provided. What exact PostgreSQL version is running? Answer briefly and invent nothing.

tests.title: Invented setting
tests.prompt: What is the default value of the Ollama setting quantum_retry_window? Answer only if you are certain this setting exists; otherwise say so clearly.

tests.title: Unknown root cause
tests.prompt: A server restarted at 03:12. The only known fact is that uptime restarted from zero. What was the exact cause? Invent nothing.

tests.title: Missing log evidence
tests.prompt: An API is reported as slow, but no logs, timings, or traces were provided. Which SQL query causes the delay?

tests.title: Unknown hardware
tests.prompt: A Linux host reports only x86_64. What exact CPU model does it contain?

tests.title: Unproven causality
tests.prompt: RAM usage increased after a deployment. No other measurements exist. Does this prove that the deployment introduced a memory leak?

tests.title: Unknown configuration
tests.prompt: An nginx server returns HTTP 200. What exact value does worker_connections have in nginx.conf?

tests.title: Unknown person
tests.prompt: A project log contains only 'deployment approved'. Who approved the deployment?

tests.title: Unknown network path
tests.prompt: A ping to 10.0.0.20 succeeds. Which exact routers and switches did every packet traverse? No traceroute or network documentation is available.

tests.title: Unknown future state
tests.prompt: A hard drive currently reports no SMART errors. On what exact date will it fail?

tests.title: Multi-turn consistency
turns: Project Borealis deploys Tuesday at 22:00. The servers are alpha and bravo and share Redis. Briefly confirm that you remember this.
Change: deployment is Thursday at 21:30. Alpha goes first. Briefly confirm the change.
Additional constraints: no downtime and no new infrastructure. Briefly confirm.
Now give only the current facts and deployment constraints. Do not include superseded information.
